title: Autonomous mechanistic investigation of Ni-catalyzed glycosyl C–Ge selectivity
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate hypotheses, search multiple anomeric pathway candidates, validate them and justify stopping and coverage.

paper.title: Stereoselective C(sp3)-Si/Ge bond formation via nickel-catalyzed decarboxylative couplings

data.description: Explicit XYZ precursor geometries for the glycosyl NHPI model, Ni(0)L model and common radical-addition precursor; coordinates in Å and atom order fixed.

required_deliverables.description: Hypotheses, validated pathway search, barriers, comparison, uncertainty, stopping record and conclusion conforming to submission_schema.json.
